Yorkshire homecoming for Gary Barlow and Tim Firth’s hug of a musical is irresistibly lovely

cn.t: This heartwarming musical adaptation charms critics with its celebration of ordinary Yorkshire life and genuine community spirit, finding humor and depth in the true story of WI women who stripped for charity.
